description: §41.13 — an alias whose right-hand side is a struct (`type Row = UserRow`) is not an alias of an enum: E-PARSEVARIANT-TYPE-NOT-ENUM.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6 (§41.13 strict keys + E-TYPE-080; `parseVariant` accepts an enum alias)
rationale: §41.13: "An alias whose right-hand side is anything else (a refinement, a union, a struct, a type expression) is still `E-PARSEVARIANT-TYPE-NOT-ENUM`."
